content: {"episode_id":"ep-05055","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and dizziness, consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, CPT 93229, was ordered to evaluate the frequency and duration of arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptomatic giddiness. Although authorization was missing and the claim was denied under CO-197, reconsideration is requested based on this documented clinical indication."}
